title: Your Path Forward
description: Meaningful change doesn’t happen all at once. It happens through honest reflection, new perspectives, and small steps that build lasting momentum.

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: Gain clarity about where you are today, what’s keeping you stuck, and what you truly want moving forward.

steps.title: Align
steps.description: Reconnect with your values, strengths, and priorities so your choices feel more intentional and authentic.

steps.title: Grow
steps.description: Create practical, sustainable changes that help you move forward with confidence and purpose.
